definitions.ply: edges including forced single passes; stop when both players cannot place
definitions.layered_total: sum_d N_d; a position reachable at different d can be counted more than once
definitions.union_total: distinct positions across all d, estimated with all-length multiplicity
definitions.tree_total: sum_d T_d (all finite game-record prefixes, including root)
definitions.d4: D4 canonicalization without color exchange; only reachable members contribute to orbit cardinality

global_deterministic_bounds.kind: deterministic bounds; shallow exact union lower and structural superset upper

structural_bounds.kind: exact combinatorial superset upper bounds, not reachable counts
structural_bounds.proof: Initial pairing is retained; every domino is monochrome. Allow all partial matchings outside its eight cells, both colours for each domino, all initial colours and both sides. Weighted frontier DP counts these exactly. Rotations preserve the fixed initial pairing. Burnside C4-orbits bound reachable D4-orbits from above even if reflections identify additional classes.
